The kingdom had long been at peace.
마왕군은 국경 너머의 소문으로만 전해졌고, 왕국군의 창끝은 무뎌진 지 오: The Demon Army was known only through rumors from beyond the border, and the spearpoints of the royal army had long since dulled. Even so, there were always rifts at the edges of the world. Valleys where monsters crawled out. Lands painted red on the map, their very names erased. Mountain passes that merchant caravans went out of their way to avoid.
과거. 그 균열 앞에 서는 이들을 사람들은 용사라 불렀다. 용사는 왕이: Long ago, people called those who stood before those rifts heroes. A hero is not a post the king appoints. It is the name given to those who stood their ground and, in the end, protected someone, or something. And those among them who shone with exceptional might each came to bear an epithet of their own.
평화가 길어지자 용사가 되는 방법도 달라졌다. 왕도를 시작으로 곳곳에 용: As the peace stretched on, the way one became a hero changed too. Hero academies sprang up everywhere, starting in the royal capital, and hopefuls learned sword and sorcery there, testing their skills in tournaments and making names for themselves. The weapons they held and the places they trained differed, but what they wanted to become was the same: someone who never steps back, even when stepping back would be allowed.
다만 길게 이어진 평화 속에서, 그 이름이 얼마나 무거운지 아는 이는 아: But in that long, unbroken peace, no one yet knew how heavy that name truly was.
a winter that felt like a lifetime came to an end.
대부분의 시설과 도구는<br>크게 불어난 빚의 이자를 갚기 위해 헐값에:
Most of the facilities and equipment
had been sold off for a pittance to pay the interest on our ballooning debt.
얼마 전까지만 해도 용사 지망생이었던 내게<br>학원장이라는 짐은 너무나:
Until recently, I had been an aspiring hero myself,
and the burden of being headmaster felt far too heavy.
학원을 닫고 돈을 벌어 빚부터 해결해야 하나,<br>밤을 지새우며 고민했:
Should I close the academy and earn money to pay off the debt first?
I agonized over it through sleepless nights.
그래서 신입생들이 찾아왔을 때 돌려보낼까도 생각했지만,<br>그 아이들은:
So when the new students arrived, I even thought of sending them away,
but they said they wanted to become heroes because they looked up to my father.
I couldn't bring myself to turn them away.
And so, I laid down my sword.
Watching the new students' bright smiles, I remembered the day I first held a sword.
어린 시절, 검을 휘두르던 아버지의 등은 한없이 커 보였다. 그렇게 나도:
As a child, my father's back as he swung his sword looked impossibly large. And so I picked up a wooden sword and began imitating him.
Those kids must have come all this way watching someone's back, too.
Here, at least, I didn't want them giving up their dreams over debt, or over a sign that might soon come down.
당장 해결해야 할 문제는 두 가지. 실적과 빚.<br>용사 학원의 인가는:
There were two problems to solve, and fast: results, and debt.
A hero academy keeps its charter through results. Fail to place in tournaments, and the sign comes down at the next renewal — and the students who just enrolled lose their place to learn.
빚 역시 기다려 주지 않는다. 인가를 지켜 내더라도 빚을 갚지 못하면 학: The debt won't wait, either. Even if we keep our charter, the academy's doors close if the debt goes unpaid.
I stood my sword at the edge of the desk and opened a new ledger.
Impressive… Truly a power worthy of the name ‘Master’.
이대로 끝내야 해요, 마스터!: We have to finish this now, Master!
마력 전부 쥐어짰어~ 더 이상은 못 버텨~: I've squeezed out every drop of mana~ I can't hold on any longer~
...이미 끝났어. 목숨은 살려주겠다. 마왕군을 전선에서 전부 철수시켜라: …It's over. I'll spare your life. Withdraw the entire Demon Army from the front.
You would shame me? Heh heh heh…
I have lost this time, but I swear I will bring about your ruin.
엄청난 중력장이 생겨나고 있어...이건! 시공간을 뒤흔드는 마력이 느껴져:
A massive gravity field is forming… This is—!
I can feel mana that's shaking space and time!!
마왕의 군세를 물리친 용사여. 운명의 커다란 뒤틀림을 느끼고 찾아왔습니다:
O hero who drove back the Demon King's legions.
I have come, sensing a great distortion in fate.
…I see.
Like this… with my power as it is now…
All I can do is leave open the smallest of possibilities.
비록 다시 깨어나면 기억 못 할지라도, 잔혹한 미래가 펼쳐져 있더라도,:
Even if you will not remember when you wake again,
even if a cruel future lies ahead,
Please, guide the intersecting fates in the right direction…
쿨럭....여긴 무슨 일이냐...학교는 어쩌고...?: Cough… What are you doing here…? What about school…?
휴학계 내고 왔어! 몸은 좀 어때?: I took a leave of absence! How are you feeling?
...미안하구나. 설마 그 녀석이 그렇게 사라질 줄은. 절대 그럴 친구가: …I'm sorry. I never thought he'd just vanish like that. He's not the kind of man who'd do that…
All I'm leaving you is a mountain of debt and an empty academy…
신경 쓰지 마! 학원쯤이야 다시 일으켜 세우면 되지!: Don't worry about it! I'll just build the academy back up!
...어려서부터 너는 타인에게 너무 상냥한 게 문제야...쿨럭: …Ever since you were little, your problem has been that you're too kind to others… Cough
I'm sorry I've been so little help as a father.
넌 네 꿈을 향해 나아가면 돼. 용사가 되고 싶다고 했었지?: You just go after your dream. You said you wanted to be a hero, didn't you?
I'm proud to have you as my son.
I'm sorry… Dad. We didn't even have the money for a proper funeral.
But at least you can see the academy right from here.
…I'll carry on your dream, Dad.
Watch over me from here.
이제 곧 봄이네! 신입생 맞이할 준비를 해야겠다!: Spring's almost here! I'd better get ready to welcome the new students!
